verdict.rationale: The SoS refers to a business-entity bulk data program, noting that 'requestor[s] of Bulk data' receive files reflecting new entity numbers. It also offers a downloadable list of active Notaries Public, so bulk extracts exist without scraping. The evidence is thin: bulk entity data appears to be request-based rather than an open self-serve download, and nothing describes its formats, refresh cadence, cost or access terms. Missing for 10: documented self-serve bulk entity/UCC/trademark extracts, file formats and update schedule, access/licensing terms, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the downloads work.
